request: Three responsive game-selection concepts, desktop two equal columns, every game uses Road Fighter style content, unified pixel-art illustration direction, original emerald/gold brand and minimal graffiti.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution responsive GAME SELECTION PAGE concept board for Thai mini game club "วงเซียน". Show THREE flat browser viewport designs side by side: large DESKTOP at left (about 53% width), TABLET in middle (28%), MOBILE portrait at right (19%), no physical device shells. Give each a small outside label "DESKTOP · 2 COLUMNS", "TABLET · 2 COLUMNS", "MOBILE · 1 COLUMN". It is normal for tablet and phone to show only the top portion of the vertically scrolling catalogue; indicate continuation naturally without shrinking all cards to fit. Desktop shows all eight games in 2 equal columns and 4 rows. CRUCIAL CHANGE from reference1: there is NO full-width special Road Fighter hero and NO three-column grid. EVERY game card now uses the same rich content, structure, dimensions and button hierarchy as the old featured Road Fighter card. Same size and equal emphasis for every game, Road Fighter included. Desktop card image on left, copy on right: small category pill, prominent game title, one short description, player-count badge and a wide gold 'เริ่มเล่น' button. All buttons aligned consistently. Tablet two columns with image above text if needed; mobile one comfortable full-width card per row with image above text, generous readable typography and tappable buttons, no side scrolling. Header position remains brand left / profile, sound, settings right; introduction 'เลือกเกมของคุณ' and 'เลือกเกม แล้วมาเล่นด้วยกัน'; four filters 'ทั้งหมด', 'อาร์เคด', 'เกมไพ่', 'ปาร์ตี้', active gold. Reference1 is palette, brand position, original Road Fighter card design and minimal graffiti reference ONLY. Reference2 is exact official yin-yang gaming emblem in gold/cream, use this rather than invented flower mark; wordmark 'วงเซียน' in warm gold and small gold 'MINI GAME CLUB'. Colors dark forest emerald #071f18 to #174d37, deep green panels, cream readable copy, warm gold #efc758 CTA and fine borders. Sparse gold spray streaks only in upper-right blank intro corner, minimalist graffiti never over text/cards. Keep clean stable grid gaps and margins.
ART DIRECTION: All eight game illustrations must belong to ONE cohesive professionally designed pixel-art asset family, consistent pixel size, limited jade/cream/gold/red/blue palette, same lighting, same level of detail, 8-bit retro sprites/scenes. Do NOT mix photoreal, 3D, smooth cartoon, unrelated portrait rendering, or disparate stock art. Road Fighter image retains colorful gray road, green grass and red car, but sits in same visual family as pixel-art card tables and pixel spies. Games and DESKTOP row order EXACT: row1 Road Fighter (อาร์เคด, 1 คน) | ป๊อกเด้ง (เกมไพ่, 2–10 คน). row2 Poker (เกมไพ่, 2–6 คน) | Spyfall (ปาร์ตี้, 3–8 คน). row3 อีแก่กินน้ำ (เกมไพ่, 3–8 คน) | Who am I (ปาร์ตี้, 3–8 คน). row4 ไพ่ตอแหล (เกมไพ่, 2–6 คน) | Undercover (ปาร์ตี้, 3–8 คน). Tablet/mobile same order. Illustrations: top-down pixel road/red car; cream playing cards on jade felt; poker cards and pixel chips; blue pixel spy in hat; old-maid paired queen cards; pixel identity character with questionmark; concealed cards/spade with playful bluff; three pixel undercover silhouettes. Do not add games, leaderboards, gameplay meters or adverts. It must look like a real implementable website with a unified responsive card component.
VARIANT 1 — '01 · PIXEL CLASSIC'. Closest to the original Road Fighter card: flush full-bleed artwork occupying 42% of each horizontal desktop card, clean deep-green copy area at right 58%, fine warm-gold border on every card, 14px corner radius. Crisp orthogonal top-down pixel scenes with restrained texture; no perspective render. All desktop cards identical height around230px. Mobile card uses artwork across top, then text and broad gold CTA. Calm emerald background, tiny gold graffiti streaks near intro. Use precise spacing and equal comfortable padding for all eight cards. Presentation board high resolution around2560x1600 landscape, sharp readable Thai.
